title: Fire-Sale of Assets
situation: You can liquidate labs, equipment, and early pipeline assets for immediate cash. It's always an option when you're desperate — but you're selling the company's future to survive its present.

options.label: Liquidate assets for cash
options.description: Immediate cash. Heavy Performance hit across most departments and a morale drop.
options.outcomeText: Trucks haul away your equipment. The survivors wonder what's left to build on.
